guide.description: A breath-played granular instrument in E minor, driven directly by your exhale: nine voices with their own waveforms, each playing random E minor arpeggios over a chord bed.

controls.action: Play a steady test breath for as long as you hold; on the device you can also breathe into the microphone.
Cycle the nine instruments; hold K2 to switch between the cat and the stick figure.
The synth follows your breath exactly: louder, softer, longer or shorter.
First macro: grain length, vowel or tape wow, depending on the instrument.
Second macro: grain density, motion depth or arpeggio level.
Third macro: filter tone or brightness.
Fourth macro: hall size and mix, shimmer or sidechain pump.
Reset that macro to its default.
Next instrument (on release).
Switch the character: cat or stick figure. The top-bar CAT / MAN button does the same.
Play a steady breath while held, for testing without the microphone.
Mute the output; release to let the tail return.
Play a steady breath while touched.
System Menu: Guide, audio routing and gains, Exit.
Organ waveform, Em9 bed, slow random arpeggio over two octaves.
Glass partials, E–B bed, sparse struck arpeggio; E4 sets the shimmer.
25 % pulse wave, Em bed, arpeggio on an eighth-note groove at 84 BPM; E2 sets the motion.
Square wave through a vowel filter, Em bed, swelling arpeggio; E1 morphs the vowel.
Sine, deep E fifths bed, slow arpeggio rising from E2.
Triangle wave, Em7 bed, lo-fi plucked arpeggio with tape wow.
Bell waveform, sixteenth-note arpeggio at 90 BPM; E2 sets its level.
Detuned supersaw, fast sixteenth-note arpeggio at 160 BPM with wavefold; E4 sets the pump.
Cmaj7 haze (inside E minor), reversed grains, gentle arpeggio and a deep room.

sections.title: Sound and timing
sections.text: The synth has no envelope of its own: its level is the level of your exhale, so it swells, holds and stops exactly as you breathe. How long you breathe sets the echo and reverb tails, from short after a quick puff to about five times longer after a breath of four seconds or more. Short wobbles inside one exhale do not end it. If your input only shows a jump when a breath starts and another when it stops, the first jump switches a steady amplifier on and the opposite jump switches it off. Everything is in E minor: grains come from a chord bed plus the captured breath, while a second voice plays random notes of E natural minor in the instrument's own waveform; both then pass through drive, filter, chorus, echo and reverb. Motion, pump and arpeggios follow each instrument's own tempo (66–160 BPM), not the outside session; a new breath after silence restarts them on the downbeat. HYPER clips by design. Silence stays silent. The microphone is read raw, without noise suppression or echo cancellation, so keep the speaker away from it or use headphones; hold K4 if the sound starts feeding back.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The instrument and all four macro positions save automatically and return on the next launch. Audio is released when the App exits.
